svg.title: Map five points to a transformed sine wave
svg.desc: One full cycle begins at pi over three, one. The maximum is at pi over two, three; the next midline crossing at two pi over three, one; the minimum at five pi over six, negative one; and the endpoint at pi, one. Amplitude two and period two pi over three are marked.
